concerns.text: The plan calls for a global permutation test with ≥ 1 000 permutations *within* nested 5‑fold cross‑validation, and a bootstrap with ≥ 200 resamples. For ~120 participants this implies on the order of 1 000 × 5 (outer folds) × 5 (inner folds) ≈ 25 000 Elastic Net model fits, plus additional fits for bootstrap and sensitivity sweeps. Running all of this on the GitHub Actions free‑tier CPU‑only runner (max 2 parallel jobs, limited wall‑clock) is unlikely to complete within the stated ≤ 6 h runtime budget and 7 GB RAM limit, making the computational plan infeasible under the platform constraints.
